records.subject: spec-guard-release-artifact
evidence: result:the package was built from the v0.35.0 tag with git archive of .claude-plugin and plugins/spec-guard plus ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json, the method that rebuilt v0.24.0 file-for-file identical to its published asset
result:release-package.py validated the artifact directory before archiving and again after extracting the archive; the archive contains no AppleDouble entries
result:the locally built archive and the downloaded published GitHub asset both have SHA-256 56c0d1e02b6a124fb6df9806c48c4960efdb4150e701a4dddf53ff95e0081ac0, matching the digest GitHub reports

content:proposal_promotion_proof.py in the package reports promotion-row-mismatch with mismatchedFields and promotion-other-rows-changed; module-insert.py allows an existing spec/<id>.md and warns about the NEEDS_PLAN stage
result:the required GitHub Actions checks validate (ubuntu-latest) and validate (macos-latest) passed on 76a1ddf, the release pull request head whose tree is identical to the tagged merge commit
